description: This Java source file defines the StandardClojureEngine class, which enables executing Clojure code within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to load Clojure namespaces, call Clojure functions, and integrate Clojure services into OFBiz's service dispatching system.

classes.name: StandardClojureEngine
classes.description: A service engine that integrates Clojure scripting into OFBiz's service framework, allowing services to be written and invoked in Clojure.

methods.name: callClojure
methods.description: Loads a Clojure namespace and invokes a specified function within it, passing in the dispatch context and a map of input parameters.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously while ignoring return values.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result as a Map, ensuring the service returned a Map object.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Handles the invocation of a Clojure-based service, including setting up the namespace and function, and handling exceptions.
